_comment: Cross-validation target for this port is the EigenLayer Sidecar API, NOT a GraphQL subgraph. The sidecar (Layr-Labs/sidecar) is a self-hosted Go service exposing a gRPC + REST API (https://sidecar-docs.eigenlayer.xyz). There is no canonical public read endpoint and no The Graph subgraph, so tools/compare cannot run automatically against a hosted endpoint. To validate: run a sidecar instance synced to mainnet (or use a hosted RPC if one is provisioned), set `subgraph.url` to its REST base, and map the entity/endpoint pairs below. The `subgraph` key name is retained for tools/compare schema compatibility; it points at the sidecar REST API here.

subgraph.note: EigenLayer Sidecar REST/gRPC API base (e.g. http://<host>:7100 for REST). No public hosted endpoint is published; provision a synced sidecar and set this. Endpoint->entity mapping: operator-shares (rpc GetOperatorShares / SQL operator_shares) -> OperatorShares; staker-shares (SQL staker_shares) -> StakerShares; delegated_stakers / GetDelegatedStrategies -> Staker; avs_operator_state_changes / registered_avs_operators -> AvsOperator; reward_submissions -> RewardSubmission; submitted_distribution_roots -> SubmittedDistributionRoot; rewards_claimed -> RewardsClaimed; operator_avs_splits/operator_pi_splits/default_operator_splits -> OperatorAVSSplit/OperatorPISplit/DefaultOperatorSplit; queued/completed_slashing_withdrawals + WithdrawalQueued/Completed logs -> Withdrawal. NOTE: many sidecar read endpoints serve OFF-CHAIN snapshot/computed values (e.g. *_snapshots, rewards gold tables) which are OUT OF SCOPE for this port and have no local counterpart.
